claims.claim: Cognex launched the In-Sight 3900 in May 2026 with embedded AI processing, up to 25 MP imaging and claimed inspection processing up to four times faster than its prior-generation vision systems, extending its edge-AI factory automation footprint.
Cognex said OneVision reached more than 100 customers from beta through general availability, with customers moving from single-line applications toward multi-site AI-vision deployments.

risks.risk: Product claims and early customer counts do not establish durable share gains, pricing power or broad production-scale adoption.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental revenue, attach rate and renewal economics attributable specifically to OneVision and the In-Sight 3900 are not disclosed in these releases.

claims.claim: Cognex completed the divestiture of its Japan-focused trading business on April 1, 2026, slightly ahead of its expected second-quarter close, for approximately $11.9 million; the divested business generated about $16 million of 2025 revenue.

risks.risk: Timely completion of a small divestiture is execution-positive but not sufficient evidence of core growth execution.

unknowns.unknown: Current-quarter organic growth, margin progression and order trends require financial-result evidence from the underwriting lane.
